messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

set: ["do not store in freezer or directly beside refrigerator cooling element", "do not store in any other container", "do not store mixed solution", "store oral suspension in the refrigerator; do not freeze", "store liquid medicine in the refrigerator; do not freeze", "store in the refrigerator or at room temperature up to 86°F (30°C)", "if stored in the refrigerator do not allow it to freeze", "store in refrigerator between 36ºF to 46ºF (2ºC to 8ºC)", "store in refrigerator between 2°C to 8°C (36°F to 46°F)", "store in refrigerator between 36°F and 46°F (2°C and 8°C)", "store in refrigerator until first use for FlexTouch single-patient-use pen", "once at room temperature, do not return to refrigerator", "do not mix in advance", "store in original bottle", "do not refrigerate or freeze", "pen can be stored in refrigerator"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
